name: turnover
plainWords: A turnover: the team with the ball gave it away, by a pass the other team intercepted or by a fumble the other team recovered. Each one is charged to the team that had the ball on the play.
comparedWith: the other team in the same game, by its own count of the same event
cannotSee: whether a fumble was forced or dropped, a turnover on downs (not a flag here), what happened after the ball changed hands, or that a muffed punt is charged to the punting team because it had the ball
